answer: The velvet is that the door answers to Maltbound mead maker market writ alone, and a writ mead makers sign after meadery audits is the lock it turns. The window charges 26 letters of reference, each one priced at £7 before it opens, and the ridge is that the fee never comes back. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Every inlet is counted once.
